sloka: स कुम्भकर्णस्य भुजो निकृत्तः पपात भूमौ गिरिसन्निकाशः।विवेष्टमानो ऽभिजघान वृक्षान् शैलान् शिला वानरराक्षसांश्च ।। ६.६७.१४९ ।।
transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇasya bhujo nikṛttaḥ papāta bhūmau girisannikāśaḥ।viveṣṭamāno 'bhijaghāna vṛkṣān śailān śilā vānararākṣasāṁśca ।। 6.67.149 ।।

translations.english: Highly energetic Kumbhakarna laughing in hideous ways making sounds like rumblings of clouds breaking the hearts of forest rangers spoke these words.
